_note: Creature-type vocabulary for the NPC system. Race files declare creatureType; the NPC wizard uses the sentient flag to choose class vs attack-package.

sentient.name: Sentient
sentient.description: Self-aware peoples (including giants, orcs, kerran). Uses classes.

animal.name: Animal
animal.description: Natural beasts. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Animated dead. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

insect.name: Insect
insect.description: Giant insects and arachnids. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

plant.name: Plant
plant.description: Animate flora. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

construct.name: Construct
construct.description: Built beings (golems, clockworks). Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Dragons, drakes, wurms. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.description: Living elements. Attacks via natural-weapon packages.
